name: Packages Durable
summary: Packages Durable is a structural module providing the durable storage layer for conversations, entries, tasks, inputs, and documents. It defines core TypeScript types for records, storage operations, and outcomes, plus an in-memory implementation of the Storage interface.
keyPoints: Defines an in-memory storage implementation (MemoryStorage) that simulates the Storage interface for durable data, including conversations, entries, tasks, inputs, and commit sequencing.
Central types describe a content-addressed model with immutable IDs (Id = number), commit sequences (Seq), and a root conversation constant (ROOT_CONVERSATION_ID = 1).
Task lifecycle states are explicitly modeled: pending, running, and terminal, with outcomes spanning completed, failed, aborted, orphaned, and faulted.
Input records track deduplication via requestId and transition through queued, placed, done, and unanswered statuses.
Data manipulated by MemoryStorage is deep-cloned to protect caller-provided objects from unintended mutation during reads.
Entries support head markers, edits (omit/replace) for context overrides, and optional model messages and JSON data.
Storage API includes cursor-based pagination, findLatestHeadMarker for active head resolution, and write commits that return a sequence number.
MemoryStorage maintains sorted ID lists for efficient binary-search-based insertion and removal, enabling low-overhead scanning and pagination.
The module is structured as a compact package with only a handful of source files, relying on external context types (like Context) for operation metadata.
Tests cover behavior of MemoryStorage operations and type-level guarantees, including the Storage interface contract.

entryPoints.name: MemoryStorage
entryPoints.note: Class implementing the Storage interface in-memory; primary implementation of durable storage without a backing database.

entryPoints.name: Storage
entryPoints.note: Interface defining the durable storage contract for operations like commit, scan, and retrieval across conversations, entries, tasks, and inputs.

entryPoints.name: TaskRecord
entryPoints.note: Type for durable task records with kind, version, input, dependencies (after), background flag, abort handling, and state machine.

entryPoints.name: EntryRecord
entryPoints.note: Type for conversation entries carrying kind, optional model messages, data payload, head reference, and context edits.

entryPoints.name: Input
entryPoints.note: Type for host-provided inputs with requestId deduplication and status transitions through the durable pipeline.
